# Vidyayatan Technologies

> Vidyayatan Technologies is an IIT-alumni-led enterprise software development
> company based in Bhopal, India, certified to ISO 9001 and ISO 27001. We build
> tailor-made web and mobile applications, SaaS platforms and AI systems for B2B
> and B2C businesses — and we build and own several education products of our
> own.

## What we are, and what we are not

We are a build partner. Clients come to us to design and build a platform, to
scale one that is buckling, or to decide whether they should be building at all.
That last one is a real part of the work: we regularly advise clients to buy an
existing product rather than commission us.

We are not a reseller, an agency layer over offshore contractors, or a single
product company.

## Our own products

These are ours. Anywhere on this site that we evaluate a category one of them
competes in, the ownership is disclosed in the body of the page, not a footer.

- **Vacademy LMS** — https://www.vacademy.io — AI-powered learning platform for
  institutes: courses, live classes, assessments, admissions, fee collection,
  white-label mobile apps.
- **Vacademy CRM** — https://www.vacademy.io/crm/ — admissions CRM with lead
  scoring, counsellor routing and an AI voice agent that qualifies leads.
- **Vimotion AI** — https://vimotion.ai/ — AI video studio: script to storyboard
  to rendered video, with a full timeline editor.

## Services

- Custom web and mobile application development
- SaaS platform architecture and build
- AI systems: retrieval, agents, evaluation, voice
- Scaling and reliability work on existing systems
- Cloud architecture and DevOps

## Editorial stance on our blog

Our writing is aimed at people making build-or-buy decisions, and it is written
to be checkable rather than persuasive:

- **Methods are published.** Where we score or rank something, the rubric and
  the weights are in the post, so you can re-weight it and get a different
  answer.
- **Numbers carry their basis.** Measured figures are labelled measured;
  extrapolated ones are labelled projected.
- **We name where our own products lose.** A comparison in which the author's
  product wins every axis is an advertisement.
- **Uncertainty is marked, not smoothed.** Where we could not verify a
  competitor's claim, the post says so rather than guessing.
